title: Business Sellers: The Truth About Non-Compete Clauses
description:
Most business owners believe one thing that is completely wrong: “Non‑competes don’t matter anymore.”

I hear it every week. And it quietly destroys deals.

In this video, I explain what is really happening with non‑competes today, what changed with the proposed FTC ban, and why non‑competes are still enforceable when you sell a business.

You’ll learn:

✅ Why non‑competes still matter in business sales
✅ Where they should live in your deal documents (and where they should not)
✅ How banks and SBA loans view non‑compete clauses
✅ Why “five years from closing” can be dangerous for buyers
✅ How carve‑outs actually work for sellers

If you are buying or selling a professional services firm, especially an accounting practice, this is not optional knowledge.
